reviews.title: Live Your Best Life, Now!
reviews.text:
The content of Breakthrough is the best of Tony’s teachings!

Short of doing Tony’s programs this is an excellent way to stay in touch with the main teachings of his courses.

I love playing these programs to stay in touch with and refine my understanding of my many experiences from Tony’s hallmark programs, like Unleash the Power Within, Life Mastery, Wealth Mastery, Date with Destiny and RPM.  :-)

I look at it as if I get to relive the experiences and deepen my breakthroughs from his big programs, so I can continue to improve and live my best life and fully enjoy my time with family and friends and accelerate my business, bonus it takes “no extra time”!  

Best of all you can do it while driving, cleaning, cooking, etc.

Highly recommended, a must have for anyone looking to live their Best Life!

reviews.title: The ultimate review
reviews.text: Tony Robbins programs are the best in the world for practical, immediately usable content and practices!  Mixed with re training our brains to choose better thoughts, it’s a winning combination for anyone who wants to make lasting change.  Highly recommend any and all programs as the information crosses over in mindset while offering program specific steps to take toward your goals.  Whether the ultimate relationship or the body you want or more abundance, this is the best place to be!

reviews.title: Absolutely wonderful!
reviews.text:
Tony Robbins has absolutely changed my life. I am so thankful to God for him. He is truly gifted in this area  of work he is in. From personal growth to relationships, to business growth and development this man has it “dialed in.”  He knows what he is talking about.  I am so thankful to have found his teaching materials, I have been listening to several of his audios for years now, but I am now diving in deeper and taking more of his courses. I wish I would have found them when I was younger, LOL. Oh well, everything happens for a reason, right? ;)

Anyway, I highly recommend this app to anyone who could use some help by the way of personal growth, or for someone who’s just looking to “refresh” or get themselves back on track, so to speak. Be blessed!

reviews.title: TRANSFORMATIONAL!!!
reviews.text: I’ve been really invested in Tony’s programs, books, and material for a few years now. The ultimate edge is truly one of the pinnacles of Tony’s effort and experience. I love all the value he provides in an audio program that I can listen to in the car, while doing chores, in between tasks, and pretty much anywhere else I can think of. He has designed it so that I don’t have to spend any extra time going somewhere to attend some thing. this is truly a gift, and a blessing! Please be aware that he aims to totally transform your life! If you’re not ready for that, don’t listen to the ultimate edge. You can’t listen to the ultimate edge without feeling anything, but a deep sense of inspiration towards the goals that will move forward! thank you, Tony! And as I know you always have your team helping out, thank you to Tony’s team! Beautiful program.
